intro: Trinidad is a large, busy island; Tobago is smaller, with reefs and rainforest.

chapters.title: Land
text: Pitch Lake in Trinidad is the world's largest natural deposit of asphalt. The Northern Range has rainforest and waterfalls. Tobago's Main Ridge is one of the oldest protected rainforests in the Western Hemisphere.

chapters.title: Birds
text: The Caroni Swamp is home to scarlet ibis, the national bird.

keyTerms.meaning: A black, sticky substance used for roads.

places.title: Landscape tour
places.intro: Places that show the variety of Trinidad and Tobago's landscapes. The numbers match the pins on the map.
